reason: Reports DPPH, ABTS and FRAP antioxidant activity of native versus steamed and air-fried orange-fleshed sweet potato peel and flesh in one table.
foods: Orange-fleshed sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas L.) peel and flesh
treatments: Native (fresh, unprocessed control); steaming at 100 °C for 15, 30, 45 min; air-frying at 160 °C for 5, 10, 15 min; all samples cooled, frozen and freeze-dried before analysis
methods_quote: The OFSP flesh and peel samples were subjected to steaming at 100 °C for 15, 30, and 45 min and air-frying at 160 °C for 5, 10, and 15 min. Fresh, unprocessed samples served as the control (native).
basis_quote: Values are expressed as dry weight (DW)
replicates: All the experiments were conducted as three biological replicates per treatment.
